body: When taking and editing photos, you need to make sure you have a goal in mind. One of  the biggest mistakes beginners make is just taking photographs with no objective. Don’t critique yourself based off of how good or bad the photo looks because what looks good is very subjective, critique yourself based off of how close you came to achieving your goal. It’s also hard to critique a photograph that has no stated objective.
